title: Validation of machine learning models for estimation of left ventricular ejection fraction on point-of-care ultrasound: insights on features that impact performance.
summary: Machine learning estimated left-ventricular ejection fraction from point-of-care ultrasound videos and was compared with five echocardiographic/expert reference standards; source notes many scans were not analyzable. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
ai_technology: Methods describe prospectively acquired POCUS data, model architecture and five reference standards; Results report agreement and performance limits by image quality.
